integrity: Self-contained analytical proof plus executable finite standard-library checks. Numerical tests corroborate, not establish, the all-parameter and asymptotic theorems. No independent assessment claimed.
scientific_limitations: Half-open modulus-one domain; fixed translation; integer a,c,e >=2; degree-two coupling; normalized Lebesgue stationary initialization; no claims about ciphertext, all invariant measures, higher lags, or noninteger gains.
title: Unavoidable one-step memory and a zeta-law coupling asymptotic in a polynomial modular map
